scope: Local Campaign progress, source wallet rewards, tutorial flag and selection state; isolated port persistence

api.initialize: OriginalLocalProgress.Open(absoluteSavePath); FromSource and OpenFromSource are explicit injection APIs for numerical/adapter checks
api.session: GameMode, Region, Stage, Level, Seed, LevelType, ShopRegion; host chooses mode and owns arena transitions
api.persistent: TutorialPassed, native ProgressData campaign/survival/ranked/grant fields, WalletData.Gold and original region/stage preference keys
api.victory: RecordVictory(absoluteHealth) returns OriginalCampaignOutcome; host owns once-per-match settlement and calls only for actual Campaign victory
api.popup: CreatePopupResult(outcome, OriginalCampaignPopupServices); actual inventory, entitlement and rewarded-ad callbacks are externally owned
api.items: GetCompletedLevelsForRegion returns the first matching RegionProgress.Levels.Count; GetCurrentRank returns the rank index calculated from saved rank points and the original 32-entry threshold configuration

source_rules.defaults: New ProgressData: tutorial false, empty campaign regions/grants, zero survival/ranked fields. New release WalletData.Gold is zero; Editor-only test fallback is not applied.
source_rules.selection_defaults: hq static initialization: mode0, region1, stage0, level1, seed0, levelType0, shopRegion1
source_rules.selection_restore: Original cwp restores raw region and optional raw stage prefs, without re-running SetStage; session level/mode/seed/type/shop region are not persisted
source_rules.set_region: Raise region event only on change; store region pref; select saved stage or (max(completedLevels,1)-1)/10; call SetStage
source_rules.set_stage: Raw stage, original dy.GetLevelType, unchecked region*stage-1 seed, stage pref, selection changed event
source_rules.stage49: Original ARM64 VA0x36617bc is MOV W19,#4. Ghidra's apparent ELF e_ident_class address must not be read as enum5.
source_rules.record_level: Only 1..3 stars at controller; valid indices0..999; append exactly at Count; retain max for an existing index; never fill a skipped index
source_rules.stars: MatchEndHandler absolute slot0 HP: ordered <=66 then <=33 tests yield stars3/2/1; health is not normalized by max health
source_rules.record_result: StarsEarned, PreviousStars, max(earned-previous,0), Calculate(earned,false)-Calculate(previous,false); worse replays can have negative Coins
source_rules.award: Only earned>previous awards; actual wallet adds the whole earned-tier Calculate reward, not result.Coins
source_rules.reward_tiers: Current level equals source region level count: final table; else level500: boss; else level%10==0: miniboss; else normal
source_rules.bonus: Calculate(stars,true)-Calculate(stars,false), positive delta only; reachable only through a real entitlement or completed rewarded-ad callback supplied by the owner
source_rules.integer_arithmetic: Native unchecked int32 reward differences, multiplication, wallet addition, seed and stage helper arithmetic are preserved

covered_native: CalculateCampaignReward, AwardCampaignReward, AwardCampaignRewardBonus and native positive gold addition
RecordCampaignWin struct and original OnLevelCompleted/RecordLevelStars byte-list mutations, errors and events
RegionProgress unlocked levels/stages, full-stage checks, star lookup and total
GetStageForLevel, dy.GetLevelType including negative and49, original System.Random ctor/Sample/Next instructions
32 source rank thresholds and adjacent points, including negative and int32 bounds
Actual Gold getter values including0 and99999999; multi-region lookup with absent and duplicate region IDs
validation.local_checks: Actual class defaults, once-per-flag events, health thresholds, complete record/award caller sequence, missing ad/inventory service handling, private snapshot isolation and own-file save/reload

external_context_and_limits: The provided mod APK's live HUD shows99999999. Its actual wallet getter only reads WalletData.Gold and its WalletData ctor has no Gold store or patched jump. The source of that mod balance in load/grant/display logic remains unresolved; new profiles are not assigned an invented99M balance.

The port's JSON envelope and atomic local file replacement are an explicit storage adapter, not original encrypted Android save compatibility or an implementation of er anti-tamper/network reconciliation.

The native oracle bounds engine object equality, collection access, logging/allocation, existing-region resolution for the record caller and er guard calls. Separate original multi-region lookup instructions are tested. This is numeric/control-flow evidence, not Android/Unity whole-game equivalence.
No rank points, server rank result, purchase, grant ID, paid entitlement or rewarded-ad completion is synthesized. Saved non-Campaign domains are retained as data only.

Absent rewarded-ad service calls cancellation; absent inventory callbacks remain null for the popup driver's explicit missing-service check. The main host supplies its recovered inventory alert owner.
Source bonus methods do not deduplicate awards. Original UI visibility and the host's once-per-match guard own eligibility; this helper does not add a different reward policy.
Source current ShopRegion is independently owned. SetCurrentCampaignRegion does not update it; the host must restore its actual setter caller when that owner is used.
Next/Retry, loss popup and actual win detection remain owned by the main match/navigation integration. No health, win count, physics or game state is injected by this service.
